title: Chef John's Baby Porchetta
description: Chef John's Italian-style baby porchetta recipe starts with a pork tenderloin, covered with an aromatic fennel rub, wrapped in bacon, then roasted.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or more to taste

steps.text: Crush fennel seeds in a mortar with a pestle for 1 minute. Add garlic, sage, black pepper, rosemary, lemon zest, salt, and red pepper flakes; pound into a thick paste, 2 to 3 minutes. Add olive oil; pound until rub is evenly incorporated.

Place pork tenderloin flat onto your work surface. Cut a slit, horizontally, ¾ of the way through middle of tenderloin, leaving 1 inch uncut on each end, being careful not to cut all the way through to the other side. Spread 1 tablespoon fennel seeds rub inside slit; close up tenderloin. Spread remaining fennel seeds rub evenly over tenderloin. Wrap bacon strips around tenderloin, trying to keep seams on the bottom.
Wrap tenderloin in plastic wrap; refrigerate for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Unwrap tenderloin; place in center of the prepared baking sheet.

Roast in the preheated oven until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads 134 degrees F (57 degrees C), about 25 minutes. Rest tenderloin until the internal temperature rises to 140 to 145 degrees F (60 to 63 degrees C), about 10 minutes.

video.description: The secret is in the spice! Begin the great flavor by grabbing your mortar and pestle to make a garlic herb rub. Crush some whole fennel seeds, then add sliced garlic, black pepper, sage, rosemary, lemon zest, chili flakes and kosher salt until it becomes a paste. Then incorporate olive oil. Spread rub seasoning all over a trimmed pork tenderloin, then wrap in strips of bacon. Transfer to a very hot oven and roast. Once you slice and serve, you’ll be treated to amazingly delicious and fork-tender meat that’s perfect for impressing at holidays and special dinners.
